course.title: Reinforced Concrete Structures - II

content.value: Design a short RC spiral column of diameter not more than 28 inch to carry a concentric allowable load of 1142 kips, $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 4 ~ \mathsf { k s i } ,$ and $f _ { y } = 6 0$ ksi. Include the design of spiral and sketch the cross and long sections of the column. Use WSD method.
